exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI categories (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: The study included 18,548 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) via a 75g glucose tolerance test.
finding: Gestational weight gain (GWG) significantly influences adverse pregnancy outcomes, and the Chinese nutrition society (CNS) recommendations and study-derived GWG ranges are more suitable for Chinese women with GDM in singleton pregnancies compared to Institute of Medicine (IOM) guidelines.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain, particularly in normal weight and overweight women, increased the risk of cesarean section.
